availability.paired_future: Per-person targets, group/global hits exist for assigned returning customers; full-returner reference is the RFM list. Nonreturners must not be assigned zero preference accuracy.
availability.value_preference: Same customer RFM labels and preference labels, representatives and historical peer example exist.
availability.stability: Three 80% subsamples at first origin for kmeans/leiden/hdbscan. Matched KMeans and RFM have no matching subsample evidence in this experiment. Do not fill with another method.
availability.new_customers: Second-origin newcomers were clustered in a full refit, not assigned by a frozen first-origin model. No zero-history customer validation or deployed online assignment.
availability.boundaries: KMeans two nearest distances only for K=4; Leiden internal edge share and HDBSCAN strength have different semantics, not interchangeable confidence.

decision: No new training. Derive matched-population, same-value-tier, coverage and pre-observable condition comparisons from all saved records. Add a fixed HDBSCAN/global fallback replay on all eligible returners; no personalized recommendation, no causal uplift, no future-based routing.
evidence: Known public development outcomes; neither new holdout nor marketing experiment.
